title: This AI Agent Built and Deployed an App From One Prompt
description:
Link to the Resource Vault: https://thenextnewthing.ai/Resources
(There is also a clickable link in my bio)

Link to the full video: https://youtu.be/W0r8xrWIYGw 

Buzz combines a Slack-style workspace, OpenClaw-style agents, and a coding agent manager in one place.

In this demo, Vince gives an agent a single instruction to build a CRM app. The agent writes it, runs tests, deploys it, verifies that it works, and returns the live URL—all from one message.
